posts.body:
Can anyone give me any recommendations for a pushchair suitable from birth please. I want it to be rear and forward facing, to lie completely flat, height adjustable handle, 4 wheels as I don't like 3 wheel ones, I'm not bothered about a car seat clipping on as I will mostly be walking everywhere. I will be buying second hand so I don't mind if it's been discontinued recently.

Thank you to anyone who can help

posts.body: Ours is the Obaby zezu. Little boy is only a week old but is great so far and only cost me £125 from kiddicare, think my model has been discontinued now but is available in green, purple, red or black so unisex colours too.
